note: Topic taxonomy. Every question topic must appear here, and every topic maps to exactly one of the four blueprint areas published by the manual on PDF p.31 (printed 21): traffic signs and signals 25%, safe driving principles 25%, rules of the road 25%, drugs and alcohol 25%.

blueprint.quote: Traffic signs and signals—25% Safe driving principles—25% Rules of the road—25% Drugs and alcohol—25%
